summary: Full backend + frontend verification of the new Category Manager. New pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_category_manager.py (13 tests, 13/13 passed) covers: public GET /api/categories (ordered by `order`, only active, no _id, first five slugs disposable/delta/delta-cartridges/delta-edibles/delta-smokeables, productCount disposable 13, delta 11, delta-cartridges 12, delta-edibles 12, delta-smokeables 11, kratom 2, glass-pipes 6 and 0 for vape-accessories/hemp-wraps/paper-cones/lighter/air-freshner/hookah-accessories/miscellaneous, default names intact), GET /api/products (67 products, per-category counts match), admin GET /api/admin/categories (superset of public, ordered), auth gating (unauth GET/POST/PUT/DELETE/reorder -> 403), PUT /api/admin/categories/kratom rename to 'Kratom & Botanicals' (slug unchanged, both kratom products' `category` renamed, public list renamed, restored to KRATOM), rename of unknown slug -> 404, POST create 'Nicotine Pouches' (slug nicotine-pouches, appended last), duplicate POST -> 409, blank name -> 400, reorder to first then back, deactivate (slug unchanged, hidden from public /api/categories but present in admin list), DELETE ok, DELETE /api/admin/categories/disposable -> 400, sitemap.xml 200 with 115 URLs and exactly the 7 unchanged /product-category/ URLs, robots.txt, POST /api/orders zelle 32801. Frontend (Playwright): public age gate + Shop dropdown shows exactly the 7 categories with active products in admin order; /product-category/kratom h1 + 2 cards; API rename of kratom propagated live to dropdown label, category h1, product-card category label and PDP (restored); API reorder putting glass-pipes first reflected in the dropdown (restored). Admin UI (/my-account login -> sidebar 'Categories'): categories-summary count, all rows in order with position numbers, category-down-disposable moved disposable to 2 / delta to 1 and persisted after reload (restored with category-up-disposable), rename via category-name-kratom + category-save-kratom persisted after reload, add-category-btn -> new-category-name -> new-category-submit created a row at the bottom (pos 16, slug text /product-category/nicotine-pouches) with a Delete button, row Delete + confirm removed a 0-product category, Active checkbox toggle on 'lighter' + Update persisted and removed it from public /api/categories (restored), no Delete button on in-use categories. ProductForm: Add Product pf-category is a <select> populated from /api/admin/categories with 'disposable' pre-selected; Edit product 1 pre-selects 'kratom'; both forms cancelled without saving. All names/order/active flags restored; test categories deleted. ONE real defect found: the 'Category updated' toast never renders (create/delete toasts do).

minor.issue: Reproduced: seed_categories() scans db.products WITHOUT filtering active:true, so the 6 soft-deleted 'TEST_ Brand Slug Product' rows (categorySlug 'vapes') keep resurrecting a stray active category 'vapes' (0 products) that shows up in GET /api/categories, GET /api/admin/categories, the Admin -> Categories list and the ProductForm pf-category select. I deleted 'vapes' via DELETE /api/admin/categories/vapes, restarted the backend, and it came back immediately (15 categories again). Fix: iterate db.products.find({'active': True}) in seed_categories (line ~1228). Same root cause re-created the junk brand 'test' (0 products) in seed_brands() after the restart -> brands went 35 -> 36; I deleted it again (now 35) but it will return on every restart. Cleanest fix: hard-delete the 10 inactive TEST_ products or filter on active in both seed functions.

Accepts arbitrary/unknown slugs silently (update_one matches nothing, returns {'ok':true}) and does not require the full slug set, so a partial list can leave duplicate `order` values. Consider validating that the submitted slugs match the existing set and returning 400 otherwise.

Very small: the endpoint returns productCount but the rename fan-out to products.category is not transactional with the category update; also the path param is slugified, so PUT /admin/categories/KRATOM silently updates 'kratom' (acceptable, just noting the implicit normalization).

ui_bugs.issue: No success feedback on Update: the 'Category updated' toast NEVER renders, although the PUT returns 200 and the change persists. Verified 5 times (rename kratom, rename a throwaway category, Active toggle on 'lighter'): PUT /api/admin/categories/... -> 200, DOM never contains 'Category updated' or 'Update failed', no console/page errors, Radix toast viewport <ol> exists and is empty. The sibling toasts DO work in the same session: 'Category created' (parent create()), 'Category deleted' (same row component) and 'Brand updated' on /admin/brands. Diagnostic: moving toast() before onSaved(data) did not help (reverted), so the ADD_TOAST dispatch itself appears to be lost/overwritten in this code path (TOAST_LIMIT is 1 in hooks/use-toast.js - suspect the immediately following setBusy(false)/refresh() render cycle). Admins get zero confirmation that a rename/activation was saved.

issues: The stray 'VAPES' row (0 products, resurrected on every backend restart) is confusing for the store owner - it looks like a real category next to VAPE ACCESSORIES.

Row layout: the Active checkbox and Update button sit in separate grid columns so the 0-product rows (with Delete) shift the Update button left relative to rows without Delete - slightly ragged vertical alignment down the list.
The 'Update' button is disabled-until-dirty (good) but its disabled state (opacity-40 emerald on white) reads as a hover/active state; a neutral disabled colour would be clearer.

action_items: Fix the missing 'Category updated' toast in /app/frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminCategories.jsx (CategoryRow.save) - update/activate currently gives no user feedback.

Filter on active products in seed_categories() (and seed_brands()) or hard-delete the 10 inactive TEST_ products, otherwise the stray 'vapes' category and 'test' brand reappear on every backend restart (verified by restart).
Optional: validate the slug set in PUT /api/admin/categories/reorder (unknown/partial slug lists are silently accepted).
critical_code_review_comments: seed_categories(): `async for p in db.products.find({}, ...)` must be `find({'active': True}, ...)` - soft-deleted products keep resurrecting categories (confirmed live).

admin_update_category() correctly keeps the slug immutable, fans the new name out to products.category and regenerates the sitemap via asyncio.create_task(refresh_static_sitemap()); category cache invalidation is called on every mutation - verified end-to-end.
category_out() excludes _id and all four category endpoints returned clean JSON.
CatalogContext.knownCats filters categoryRecords by products having that slug, so 0-product/inactive categories can never leak into the header/footer/home pills - verified in the browser.
server.py is now 1953 lines; the category router is the 4th feature block added to it - split into routers (catalog/brands/categories/admin/orders/seo).

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all category flows verified; only the 'Category updated' toast fails)

seed_data_creation: Created and deleted via API/UI: categories 'Nicotine Pouches' (nicotine-pouches) and 'TEST_ Temp Cat' (test-temp-cat). Renamed kratom -> 'Kratom & Botanicals' and back to 'KRATOM' several times; reordered (disposable/delta swap, glass-pipes first) and restored the original order; 'lighter' toggled inactive and back to active. Deleted the stray category 'vapes' and the junk brand 'test' (both regenerate on backend restart). One TEST_ zelle order created by the pytest smoke test. No products were modified.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Category Manager is functionally correct. Baseline right now: 14 real categories in the documented order (disposable, delta, delta-cartridges, delta-edibles, delta-smokeables, vape-accessories, hemp-wraps, paper-cones, kratom, glass-pipes, lighter, air-freshner, hookah-accessories, miscellaneous) + a 15th stray 'vapes' that reappears after every backend restart (seed_categories does not filter inactive products); 67 products, 35 brands (a junk brand 'test' also reappears on restart), sitemap 115 URLs. Regression suite: `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_category_manager.py -p xdist -n 0` (pytest.ini requires xdist; assertions tolerate extra categories but assume the 14 defaults and the 7 counted categories). Playwright notes: age gate is data-testid=age-gate-yes; admin login via /my-account login-email/login-password/login-submit; header 'Shop' must be hovered (page.get_by_text('Shop', exact=True).first.hover()) to reveal shop-dropdown/nav-cat-<slug>; admin sidebar link is admin-nav-categories; row selectors category-row-/pos-/up-/down-/name-/slug-/active-/save-/delete-<slug>; the confirm() on delete needs page.once('dialog', d.accept()); in-page admin fetches work with localStorage p2d_token; external Python HTTP calls from the Playwright tool need a browser User-Agent header (plain urllib gets 403 from the edge).
rca_of_the_issue: (1) Missing 'Category updated' toast: the PUT succeeds (200) and state updates, but the ADD_TOAST never reaches the Toaster. Toasts from the parent component (create) and from the same row's delete handler render fine, so the Toaster/use-toast wiring is healthy; the loss is specific to save(), whose continuation also runs setCats + CatalogContext refresh() + setBusy(false) in the same tick (TOAST_LIMIT=1). Reordering toast() before onSaved() did not fix it (change reverted), so the developer should debug the save() render cycle (e.g. dispatch the toast in a setTimeout/after setBusy, or de-couple refresh()). (2) Stray 'vapes' category + junk 'test' brand: seed_categories()/seed_brands() derive their lists from ALL products including the 10 soft-deleted TEST_ products left by earlier iterations; deleting the category and restarting the backend reproduced the resurrection in one step.
